Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center, the grille bracket is bent, and
the hood latch and both headlamp assemblies show impact marks consistent with a
frontal stirke at low speed. The radiator support has a slight shift that fits the same
force path. Nothing on the vehicle points to older or unrelated damage. The proposed
plan replaces the bumper cover, grille bracket, and affected lamp assemblies, then
realigns the hood and checks the cooling system. The labor hours submitted run roughly
three times what this scope normally requires, so the shop should itemize each task. A
duplicate entry for one service also appears on the invoice, which the provider has
acknowledged as a repeat. Those lines need correction before payment review.
</page>
